learning_objective: 🎯 We will have fun counting, adding, and taking away yummy vegetables from the farm!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Look at the big green farm! How many red tomatoes do you see? Point with your little finger and count them one by one.
You have 2 carrots. Your friend gives you 2 more. Put them together! Now you have 4 crunchy carrots in your basket.
You have 5 potatoes. You give 2 to Mummy for cooking. How many are left? Now you have 3 potatoes left!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 🥗 Yummy Salad Math!
fun_activity.instructions: Take 3 pieces of cucumber and 2 pieces of carrot. Count them all together! Tell your parents the total number before eating your healthy salad.

quick_recap: ⭐ We learned how to count fresh vegetables on a farm.
⭐ We learned to use the plus (+) sign to add more vegetables.
⭐ We learned to use the minus (-) sign when we take vegetables away.
